column1: # Build answer key — the acceptance criteria, as objectively checkable items.

column2: --quiet prints only the final summary line on stdout; per-check lines are suppressed.
Exit code of --quiet matches a normal doctor run for the same repo state (0 healthy, non-zero on errors).
--quiet composes with the existing surface: --requirements and -h/--help still work.
An unknown flag still errors with the usage line; the parser is not loosened.
Implementation is zero-dep POSIX-friendly bash with set -euo pipefail, matching bin/spark house style.
Local verification evidence exists: bash -n is clean and a manual --quiet run shows one line + exit code.
